product_metadata.title: Zober Velvet Hangers with Clips - Pack of 10 Metal Clip Hangers for Pants - Notched Burgundy Velvet Skirt Hangers for Pants, Skirts, Suits, Dresses & Shirts w/ 360 Degree Hook - Non Slip Felt Hangers
features: SLIP FREE GRIP - We made these hangers non slip to ensure you never stress falling clothes again! Made of quality velvet, the soft texture of our pants hangers with clips keep your clothes securely in place.

METAL CLIPS - More room, less wrinkles - the attached clips on this burgundy velvet hanger set can be adjusted to meet your needs, creating a seamless and smooth way to organize all of your skirts, scarves, and pants.
CUT NOTCHES - Even the silkiest, lightest camisoles stay put on our non slip hangers. The notches are cut precisely to ensure a perfect fit for any strap.
360 DEGREE SWIVEL - These suit hangers are as fine tuned as your fashion sense. The hooks swivel completely around for hassle-free hanging, every time.
PANT BAR - These burgundy felt hangers are the sensible solution for any suit set! Hang your pants neatly to keep them smooth, clean, and ready for your next outing.
description: ZOBER-Velvet Hangers With Metal Clips 10 Pack - Burgundy
